No bare 14ct S-link chain comp with weight. | chrome: Terapeak AU 90d '14ct gold serpentine chain' (0), '14k gold s link chain' (0), '14ct gold chain grams' (4 rows), '14ct gold chain' (noisy, gold-filled), 'solid 585 14k gold chain necklace' (2); Terapeak US 90d '14k serpentine chain grams' (20+ linked rows with weights); meltvalue.com.
chrome_hint: eBay AU sold/completed: '14ct gold serpentine chain' and '14k gold S link chain necklace' (match weight in grams; fine S-link chains usually 3-6g). Terapeak: '14ct yellow gold serpentine chain'. Also Noble Numismatics archive 'gold serpentine chain', Leonard Joel and Theodore Bruce 'gold chain 14ct' results. Also check the current AUD spot gold price for scrap value per gram (14ct is 58.3% gold).
viewing_check: Find the 14K/585 stamp on the clasp or end tag (loupe). Weigh it (this sets the bid: max about A$77 per gram less A$85, i.e. 4g A$220, 5g A$300). Measure length. Check for kinks in the S-links (kinked serpentine is hard to fix and sells as scrap) and that the spring ring works.
rate_note: All prices are AUD hammer, no conversion needed.
